run_example_no_filter: run the example_no_filter function to call an MCP tool with no allowed_tools filter, allowing all tools from the server
run_example_wildcard: run the example_wildcard function to call an MCP tool with allowed_tools set to wildcard for explicit all-tool access
run_example_specific_tools: run the example_specific_tools function to filter an MCP server to only specific sub-tools like search
run_example_object_format: run the example_object_format function to use object-format allowed_tools with tool_names and read_only fields
run_main: run the main function to execute all four MCP allowed_tools examples sequentially
